- **Top Customers**: 3 customers with most amount due (highest first), aggregating multiple invoices per customer

- Status counting with mixed invoice states
- Outstanding calculation (includes issued and partially_paid, excludes draft and paid)

- Overdue tracking with counts and amounts
- Top customers identification (highest due amount first)
- Proper limiting to 3 customers
- Aggregation of multiple invoices per customer
- Edge cases (empty list, single customer, boundary conditions)
